about:
U.S. Fabricating LLC is headquartered in Naugatuck, Connecticut. The company traces its roots to 1976 when USFab began fabricating precision sheet metal parts. In early 2025, Hi-Tech Fabricating and Quality Sheet Metal, Inc. merged to form U.S. Fabricating, combining over 40 years of collective experience.

The shop provides full contract manufacturing and assembly services, including lights-out production, design engineering, laser cutting, turret punching, forming, welding, hardware insertion, and finishing. Equipment includes Amada fiber lasers, press brakes up to 88 tons, a Keyence CMM, and a calibrated granite surface plate. The facility runs on Metalsoft Fabriwin and Amada programming suites with an E2 ERP system for job tracking.

Customers span medical, telecommunications, transportation, pharmaceutical, electronics, computer, aerospace, hardware, security, and material handling industries. The company emphasizes long-term relationships, noting many clients have been served for more than 40 years.

U.S. Fabricating differentiates itself with rapid quoting (24–48 hours) and project turnaround as fast as one week, in-house certified engineering support, ISO 9001:2015 certification with statistical process control, and traceable calibration per MIL-1-45208A.

name: US Med-Equip
old_description: US Med-Equip Recognized as One of Modern Healthcare’s Best in Business
about:
US Med-Equip is headquartered in Charleston, West Virginia. The company operates as a national provider of medical equipment rentals, sales, and biomedical services to hospitals and health systems.

The company maintains a fleet of over 160,000 pieces of equipment across more than 100 locations nationwide. Its services include movable medical equipment rentals and sales, beds and therapeutic surfaces, biomedical preventive maintenance and repair, asset management, system shutdown support, and telemetry monitoring. Manufacturer-certified biomedical technicians service all equipment, and the company offers free delivery on rentals with a target of two hours plus drive time.

US Med-Equip serves hospitals and health systems across the United States. Customer testimonials reference partnerships with North Memorial Health, Select Specialty Hospitals, CHI San Franciscan Rehabilitation Hospital, Sentara Princess Anne Hospital, Malbis Freestanding Emergency Department, Dignity Health, Prisma Health, Cook Children's Medical Center, Encompass Health, Hackensack Meridian Health, and Atrium Health.

The company's stated mission is to promote the healing process by providing smart solutions for healthcare partners and patients. It differentiates itself through its GoUSME Connect™ technology platform, which enables clinicians to secure equipment on demand, and a service model that treats every order as if it were for a family member.

about:
US Sports & Apparel was established in 2014 in Marlborough, Massachusetts. The company is led by CEO Annie Nutter, President Ben Nutter, and VP of Production TJ LaPlante, who oversee strategy, sales, operations, and production innovation.

The company operates a production facility in Marlborough where it applies embroidery, screen-printing, sublimation, heat transfers, digital transfers, and heat lamination to a wide variety of apparel, uniforms, and accessories. It also manages an online store platform that lets organizations handle ordering and payment directly. For high-volume or specialty orders, US Sports & Apparel works with a network of subcontracted partners held to its quality standards. Garments are sourced from numerous brands, covering materials from cotton to moisture-wicking technical fabrics.

Clients include corporations, small businesses, schools, colleges, booster clubs, sports leagues, and individuals. The product range spans branded workwear, team uniforms, spirit wear, facility equipment, and promotional items such as drinkware, golf balls, and decorated outerwear for supporters, patrons, athletes' parents, and booster clubs.

US Sports & Apparel emphasizes in-house production for quality control and fast turnaround, supported by trained staff who manage orders from placement through delivery. Account representatives assist with product selection, branding, and budget adherence. The company ships throughout the United States and Canada.

name: USA Auto Parts
old_description: Established in 2009, USA Auto Parts Inc. is one of the top online auto parts and accessories distributors in the United States. .
about:
USA Auto Parts Inc. was established in 2009 in Cicero, Illinois, a suburb of Chicago. The company operates as an online distributor of automotive parts and accessories, serving both retail consumers and wholesale buyers across the United States. No founders are named in public materials, and ownership structure has not been disclosed.

The distributor maintains a catalog of more than 550,000 SKUs sourced from aftermarket manufacturers, covering domestic and foreign vehicle makes and models. Order fulfillment is handled through several strategically located warehouses nationwide, enabling rapid processing and delivery. The company does not manufacture parts; it aggregates inventory from suppliers and manages logistics for direct-to-door shipment.

Customers include individual vehicle owners seeking replacement parts and wholesale accounts such as repair shops and fleet operators. The platform supports search by year, make, model, engine, and VIN, and offers a dedicated wholesale login for business-to-business transactions. Industries served center on the automotive aftermarket, including collision repair, maintenance, and performance accessories.

USA Auto Parts emphasizes discounted pricing—up to 70 percent off retail—backed by a price-match guarantee, free shipping on orders over $50, flexible payment plans, and extended warranty options. The company positions its multi-warehouse network as a key differentiator for faster delivery compared to single-location competitors.

name: Ultimate Truck Off Road
old_description: Ultimate Truck Off Road is the largest and longest running 4×4 parts and accessory business in Omaha.
about:
Ultimate Truck Off Road operates from a 3,000-square-foot showroom in Omaha, Nebraska. The business was founded in November 1990 by Scott Benson in the Millard area and relocated to its current site after 24 years. In January 2019, Benson sold the company to Matt Fryman and Marty Choyeske, who continue to run the retail and installation operation.

The shop specializes in off-road parts and accessories for trucks, Jeeps, and SUVs, carrying lines such as BDS Suspension with its “No Fine Print Warranty.” Beyond retail sales, the team provides full vehicle customization and installation services, including lift kits, wheels, tires, and fleet upfitting. An online Interactive Garage lets customers configure builds and request quotes before visiting the showroom.

Customers range from individual off-road enthusiasts to commercial fleets needing accessory packages. The company serves the Omaha metro area and surrounding cities, with testimonials citing work on personal dream trucks and fleet vehicles alike.

The company emphasizes a consultative approach: staff guide buyers toward products that match both looks and functionality rather than pushing sales. Its longevity and authorized-dealer status for brands like BDS Suspension are presented as markers of reliability in the local market.

name: Ultralife Corporation
old_description: Designs and manufactures lithium batteries and energy/communications systems
about:
Ultralife Corporation is headquartered in Newark, New York, where it operates a 280,000-square-foot manufacturing and office facility. The company is publicly traded on NASDAQ under the ticker ULBI. While its exact founding year is not disclosed in public materials, Ultralife has grown through strategic acquisitions, integrating brands such as Accutronics, Electrochem Solutions, Excell Battery, and Southwest Electronic Energy Group into a single global operation.

The company designs and manufactures lithium-based batteries, battery packs, chargers, and RF power systems for mission-critical applications. Its production capabilities span high-volume lithium-ion and thionyl chloride cell manufacturing at sites in Newark, Raynham (Massachusetts), and Shenzhen (China), as well as low- to high-volume pack assembly in Houston, the UK, Canada, and India. Ultralife offers more than 350 standard products and provides custom engineering, ruggedization, and lifecycle support lasting 10–15 years in the field.

Ultralife serves government and defense agencies, medical OEMs, industrial and oil-and-gas operators, and commercial customers. Its systems power ruggedized edge servers for Hewlett Packard Enterprise, hot-swappable medical cart batteries, downhole drilling monitors, autonomous underwater vehicles, surgical robots, and measurement-while-drilling tools. The customer base includes hundreds of global OEMs and defense contractors.

Ultralife differentiates itself by focusing on applications where commodity solutions fail, offering deep technical integration with customer design teams, a global footprint with manufacturing redundancy, and ISO 9001 and ISO 13485 certified quality systems. Financial stability as a NASDAQ-listed company and a transparent new-product-development workflow further support its position as a Tier 1 supplier.

about:
Operating in Warwick, Rhode Island, this UniFirst location provides uniform rental and facility services to businesses across the region, including Cranston, Greater Warwick, Newport, and Providence. The branch is part of UniFirst Corporation, a national provider of workplace uniform programs and facility service solutions.

The Warwick facility delivers a full-service uniform rental program that covers garment selection, sizing, personalization, scheduled pickup and delivery, hygienic laundering, repairs, and inventory management. In addition to uniforms — ranging from industrial workwear and flame-resistant garments to scrubs and high-visibility apparel — the location supplies facility services such as restroom, hygiene, and cleaning products with managed restocking. The service model relies on a local Triple-Pro Service Team composed of a route service representative, a service manager, and a customer service representative assigned to each account.

The company serves a broad spectrum of industries, including automotive repair, healthcare, energy and utilities, manufacturing, transportation and warehousing, food processing and service, agriculture, education, hospitality, and life sciences. Programs are tailored to sector-specific requirements, such as HACCP-compliant workwear for food environments, ANSI-rated high-visibility and arc-rated garments for utility crews, and hygienically cleaned scrubs for medical settings.

UniFirst emphasizes its Triple-Pro Service Team structure and a VIP Cost Analysis Program designed to reduce total cost of ownership. The company states that its managed approach — combining consistent delivery, hygienic laundering, and proactive inventory control — is intended to eliminate uniform shortages, billing errors, and service disruptions.

about:
Unicomp GA LLC operates from Lexington, Kentucky, where it manufactures the original buckling-spring "Model M" keyboard. The company traces its lineage to 25 years of production for IBM, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. No founder names or ownership structure are publicly stated.

The firm produces a range of clicky keyboards—including the New Model M, Mini M, SpaceSaver M, and a Mac variant—using new tooling at its Kentucky facility. It maintains a catalog of over 2,000 keyboard variations and offers a configurator tool that lets customers specify language layouts, colors, and features for build-to-order units. Stocked bestsellers are shipped directly from inventory.

Unicomp's customer base includes IBM, which sourced the buckling-spring design for decades, along with thousands of individual users worldwide. The keyboards are marketed to data-entry professionals and enthusiasts who prefer the tactile feedback of the original Model M design.

The company positions itself as the sole source of the authentic Model M, emphasizing that its buckling-spring mechanism is not an imitation but the original technology refined over 25 years. Custom configurations are manufactured on demand in Lexington, distinguishing it from resellers of third-party clones.

about:
Union Furniture Manufacturing Company has operated from Fort Smith, Arkansas since 1959, when Ruley Sutton founded the business. More than six decades later, the company remains family-run: Sutton and his two sons, Dewayne and Jeff Sutton, oversee daily operations.

The shop produces upholstered living-room furniture—sofas, love seats, chairs, ottomans, and sectionals—in rustic, contemporary, traditional, and transitional styles. A crew of 11 to 15 skilled employees builds frames, installs springs, and applies a rotating selection of fabrics and textiles. The company does not disclose facility square footage or annual volume, but it emphasizes a made-to-order approach for its dealer network.

Union Furniture sells exclusively to furniture dealers, serving both large regional chains and small family-owned retailers. It does not offer direct-to-consumer sales.

The founding goal was to deliver high-quality upholstered furniture at a fair price while keeping fabric selections current.
